scope: File-byte integrity and stated path/regular-member contracts; not empirical/scientific acceptance

findings.late_source_mutation: resolved by final complete inventory and file-hash recheck
findings.symlink_metadata: resolved by rejecting nonregular archive members

limitations: Source files must be quiescent; no filesystem snapshot or adversarial-writer lock is provided.
Archive manifests establish integrity relative to their trusted recorded hashes, not independent authenticity.
Empty directories and original permissions are not preservation targets.
